scope: Proposition 2.1 (The marked chamber) of the manuscript “A PD4 group without an aspherical manifold model” (preprints/A-PD4-group-without-an-aspherical-manifold-model-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 305 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ccbbf7f15686b6f7), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: There are a compact connected oriented smooth four- manifold D, its connected boundary S, a finitely generated free group H, and a map c : D → BH with the following properties. 1. The map c induces an isomorphism on fundamental groups, and D has the homotopy type of a finite graph with 2k two-spheres attached at its basepoint. Its module π2D has a specified hyperbolic basis over ZH, represented by framed immersed spheres with vanishing quadratic self-intersection obstructions. 2. Attach a three-cell to each basis sphere, and denote the resulting space by P. Then (P, S) is an oriented Poincaré pair of formal dimension four, and P ≃ BH. The boundary marking is c|S : S → BH. 3. There is no compact oriented topological four-manifold D′ with boundary identified with S and a homotopy equivalence c′ : D′ → BH whose restriction to S is homotopic to c|S.
